$sources: Measures and colours: the as-built pond's marginal irises (windows/Source/MuseeVision/Salon/SalonPond.cpp, IrisClump and IrisFlower): 5-7 fans of 4-7 sword leaves 0.62-0.78 m, flower stalks 0.44-0.56 m above the water from feet 0.12 m under it, 2-3 flowers a clump.

The species: Iris laevigata Fisch., the Japanese water iris: a marginal of shallow water, leaves to about 0.8 m, flowers blue-violet, 8-12 cm, each fall with a narrow white-to-yellow signal (B. Mathew, The Iris, Batsford 1981, series Laevigatae).
name: Iris laevigata
note: Flower heights are from the soil of the shelf, 0.12 m under the water: 0.44-0.56 m above the water, as built. In flower from Mangzhong to Xiazhi; the oval shows it in flower.
